customer: Hi there, so I run a little catering business out of Eastvale and I've been leasing this hybrid sedan for a while now, which has been great for deliveries honestly, but I'm thinking of switching to something bigger. The lease is through Crescent Motor Credit and I was wondering if Northwind could just buy it out from them directly? I'd rather not deal with a bunch of paperwork if I can avoid it, things are hectic with the holidays coming up.
agent: Thanks for reaching out! According to our article "Which leasing companies allow third-party buyouts," Crescent Motor Credit unfortunately doesn't allow us to buy out your lease directly. You do still have options, though: you can buy the car out yourself first and then sell it to us, or return it at the end of the lease. Our "Selling vs. turning in at lease end" article can help you compare those two paths.
